comparison.demonstrated: Normalization, solver, loading protocol, initial amplitude, and fit-start envelope are comparable. The PPC-4096 individual-seed late magnitude is lower, but its phases remain much more coherent, so abs(mean complex mode) has a higher reducer floor.
comparison.not_demonstrated: The archives do not isolate why the independently generated PPC-4096 loading retains more late-time coherence; marker count, recurrence, and loading-realization effects are confounded.

rows.envelope_definition: 49-sample centered geometric mean of abs(coherent complex seed mean), edge padded
rows.floor_definition: minimum rolling median of envelope over complete 5-time-unit windows stepped by 1 in [70,90]
rows.loading: global inverse-normal quiet-start template, independently shuffled for vx and vy over all particles with the frozen seed
rows.particle_relation: same seed identifiers but independently generated global shuffles; not nested particles
